text.description_html:
Stanley Security 32726D Satin Chrome Heavy Weight Steel Wardrobe Pivot

This is a Stanley 327 Heavy Weight Steel Wardrobe Pivot. It is ideal for wardrobe doors. The bearings can take vertical and lateral loads. The Stanley Security 32726D Satin Chrome Heavy Weight Steel Wardrobe Pivot is designed for mullion or face frame mounting. Doors can be installed floor-to-ceiling.

Features and Specifications of the Surface Mounted Center Hung Pivot Hinge:

  • Material: Steel
  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • For overlay doors 1-3/8" (35 mm) to 1-3/4" (44 mm) thick doors.
  • Load Capacity: 150 lbs.
  • Door Leaf Thickness: 0.2"
  • Frame Leaf Thickness: 0.2"
  • Door Leaf Height: 3"
  • Door Leaf Width: 2-1/2"
  • Frame Leaf Height: 3"
  • Doors can be opened 180º
  • Non-Handed

Sold Individually

Special Ordered Item. No Returns
